pages.title: Trybike 2 in 1 Balance Bike Vintage Pink
pages.description: Trybike 2 in 1 Balance Bike Vintage Pink, beautifully made with durable construction, stunning details & a quality finish, with wide inflatable Rubber Tyres
pages.ld_description:
Trybike 2 in 1 Balance Bike Vintage Pink has been beautifully made with durable construction, stunning details and a quality finish, with wide inflatable Rubber Tyres that offer your child a more comfortable ride even over rougher surfaces.

Trybike 2-in-1 kids balance bike is ideal for helping your child transition from crawling, to walking, to balancing, to riding. Suitable from 15 Months as a Trike, later converting to a Balance Bike which is suitable for up to 6 years.

Kids on Balance Bikes learn their balance unbeknownst to themselves, whilst having fun, with the added bonus that when they graduate to bigger pedal bikes they can do so without training wheels.

Trybike is the perfect next step for your child as they go from walking to learning how to cycle. Most children will learn how to master a pedal bike within 1 or 2 hours if they are an experienced Trybike rider!

This Trybike Steel Framed combination 2-in-1 bike can be converted from a trike into a Balance Bike with a few simple steps.

Each Trybike 2 in 1 Balance Bike Vintage Pink comes with sticker sheets with loads of designs to choose from so you can customise your Trybike! Or even create a retro feel by adding a classic wicker basket to the front

 



 

 	12 inch spoked steel wheels with nylon bushings, sealed smooth cartridge ball bearings and extra wide rubber inflatable tyres
 	Beautiful Matte Pink Finish
 	Comes with a set of vinyl stickers for you to personalise your bike
 	Unique
